insights: British Flag defect |PA|²+|PC|²−(|PB|²+|PD|²) for a parallelogram (C=B+D−A) is independent of P and equals 2(AB·AD)
Defect has intrinsic diagonal form (|AC|²−|BD|²)/2 with no preferred base vertex
Equality holds (for one P, equivalently all P) iff AB·AD=0; British Flag theorem is the right-angle case
